deviceform_channelcheck_gateway_bind_bod: The relay reports: {error}. Free port {port} on the relay, or choose another gateway port in the Relay panel of {relay}'s page. To see which program holds the port on the relay:
deviceform_channelcheck_gateway_closed_b: The site's machines go through the relay's gateway, which is off for this relay. On {relay}'s page, in the Relay panel, turn on “{setting}” and save: the relay opens it within seconds.
deviceform_channelcheck_gateway_loopback: The agent.yaml of {relay} binds the gateway to the loopback, so no other machine of the site can reach it. On the relay, replace the gateway_listen line with this one (or remove it), then restart the agent:
deviceform_channelcheck_gateway_no_tunne: Its gateway listens, but {relay} reaches this server over the web port only, so it cannot carry the site's agents. Check that {relay} reaches the server's encrypted agent port (published in Docker and open in the firewall): the relay switches to it on its own.
{relay} is not on the encrypted agent channel
deviceform_channelcheck_gateway_offline_: {relay} has not reported for a while, so it can neither open nor carry its gateway. Check that its agent is running and reaches this server; this check carries on by itself.
deviceform_channelcheck_gateway_tested_b: Tested by {relay} itself at {address}, {when}. This test does not cross a firewall between the site's machines and the relay.
deviceform_channelcheck_gateway_too_old_: A relay opens a gateway from agent {min} on. Update the agent on {relay} (from its page, or by running its install command again); this check then carries on by itself.
{relay} runs agent {version}, which has no gateway

devicesb_relay_panel_gateway_no_tunnel: The relay is not on the encrypted agent channel yet: the gateway cannot carry the site's agents.
devicesb_relay_panel_gateway_too_old: Agent {version} is too old to open a gateway: update it.
